name: Nissa Firestone
summary: Nissa Firestone is a dwarven physician stationed above the bustle of the Great Forge in Ironforge. She serves as an instructor in field medicine, teaching travelers and soldiers how to dress wounds and bind trauma.

sections.title: A Healer Above the Anvils
sections.body: Amid the clanging metal and blistering heat of the Great Forge, Nissa Firestone practices medicine from the upper floor of the Ironforge Physician shop. While dwarven warriors are famed for their endurance, even stone-hard skin splits against blade and claw. Nissa ensures that those heading out into the snows of Dun Morogh or beyond know how to keep themselves and their allies alive with basic bandaging and field dressings.

sections.title: Triage and Advanced Trauma
sections.body: For field medics who have mastered the basics of cloth and lint, Nissa recognizes when a student has outgrown her clinic. When practitioners reach the limits of what she can teach, she points them toward specialized triage officers in far-flung outposts, directing skilled healers to where the Alliance's casualties are heaviest.

faq.answer: Nissa Firestone is a dwarf first aid trainer who operates out of the Ironforge Physician shop, located on the southern perimeter of the Great Forge.

faq.q: Where can I find Nissa Firestone?
faq.answer: She can be found on the upper floor of the Ironforge Physician shop, which sits on the southern edge of the Great Forge ring in Ironforge.
She instructs Alliance adventurers in the art of First Aid, teaching the craft of preparing bandages and antidotes to treat injuries sustained in the field.
No. Once a medic reaches advanced proficiency, Nissa directs them elsewhere via the Alliance Trauma assignment, sending them to seasoned field surgeons stationed near active war zones.

angles.text: For dwarves returning from skirmishes with troggs or frost trolls, Nissa represents the practical, no-nonsense approach of Ironforge's medical tradition.
Any Alliance adventurer passing through Khaz Modan relies on trainers like Nissa to acquire essential survivability skills without needing divine or arcane magic.
